rationale: Decline table effects before execution when their indexes need maintenance absent from the current sink. Normal fallback can execute the legacy implementation; forcing new RBO without fallback receives an error instead of corrupting indexes.
verification_plan: Check explicit rejection in forced no-fallback mode; enable normal fallback and verify both base and index contents; retain sink-supported ordinary/compact controls.
verification_limitation: Correctness guard: unsupported index-maintenance paths reject before execution, allowing normal legacy fallback. Forced no-fallback mode receives an error.

resolved_verification_limitations.limitation: Earlier native checks passed before exact executable receipts were required; rebuild and rerun are required for final acceptance.

remaining_qualifications: This is guard/routing coverage. Forced no-fallback must reject at target; enabled fallback is legacy execution, not unsupported new-RBO effect support.
